You gain the following features:

Alter Form: You can spend 1 minute performing a ritual to alter you or another willing creature's physiology. Until you finish a respite, or until you use this ritual again, the target can gain one of the following benefits:

  • They can automatically climb at full speed while moving.

  • They can automatically swim at full speed while moving and can breathe underwater.

  • They can change their physical appearance and voice to mimic a creature who they've seen before, but their size can't change. They gain an edge on tests made to convince other creatures that they are that person.

Manipulate Density: You gain the following maneuver.
